findings.name: Low contrast text
findings.description: Text does not meet WCAG AA contrast requirements (4.5:1 for body, 3:1 for large text). Increase the contrast between text and background.

findings.name: Overused font
findings.description: Inter, Roboto, Fraunces, Geist, Plus Jakarta Sans, and Space Grotesk are used on so many sites they no longer feel distinctive. Each new wave of AI-generated UIs converges on the same handful of faces. Choose a face that gives your interface personality.

limitations: This proposal remains awaiting user review; only directly presented and explicitly accepted scopes enter the visual baseline.
All runtime values are synthetic. HTML makes no external or live service requests. Refresh simply restores the sample fixture; it does not simulate independent polling.
Current React baseline uses intercepted GET fixtures. No live authentication, actual service health or full-stack smoke has been tested.
The production10-second visible single-flight and independent requests/cache scopes, stale timestamps, safe cancellation and administrator realm restrictions remain implementation requirements.
Recovery timing keeps exact string milliseconds, including zero and unavailable; no local countdown.
Raw missing values remain Not observable. Metric strings, opaque epochs, units and window boundaries are not combined or interpreted as global health.
synthetic_window is an illustrative window-scope row, not a statement that an existing producer emits it.
Status source tabs and mobile record layouts are new proposed presentation, not previously approved behavior.
Other administrator destinations show scope notices and have no real navigation in this prototype.
Full source-specific error details and all asynchronous failure transitions require production implementation verification.
No service was started. Existing root Vite was borrowed and preserved; task browser contexts are closed.
